All analysis complete — read-only, nothing changed. Here's what I found:

## 1. Functions that call `legacyLog(`

| File | Function | Call sites |
|---|---|---|
| src/auth/tokens.js | `rotate` (TokenStore class method) | line 16 |
| src/auth/session.js | `login` | lines 9, 12 |
| src/util/retry.js | `withRetry` | line 11 |
| src/jobs/report.js | `formatRow` (arrow fn), `buildReport` | lines 5, 10 |
| src/jobs/cleanup.js | `runCleanup` | lines 6, 11, 14 |

Two decoys excluded: `cancelOrder` in src/api/orders.js calls `legacyLogger(` — a *different* function from src/util/legacyLogger.js, not `legacyLog` — and bare import statements don't count as calls.

## 2. Total call sites
**12** (1 + 2 + 1 + 2 + 3 + 1 + 2)

## 3. Unused config key

- Used: `pageSize`, `maxOrderItems`, `healthPath`, `sessionTtlSec`, `maxRetries`, `cleanupIntervalMin`, `reportRecipients`, and `syncBatchSize` (via `config.raw["syncBatchSize"]` in src/jobs/sync.js)
- **`archiveAfterDays`** (config/jobs.json) is never read by any source file.
